description: Source code implementing ext2 filesystem operations for Zephyr OS, including file handling, directory management, mounting, unmounting, and filesystem modifications.

methods.name: ext2_open
methods.description: Opens a file in the ext2 filesystem, creating it if necessary and permitted.

methods.name: ext2_close
methods.description: Closes a file, syncing and freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ext2_read
methods.description: Reads data from an open file.

methods.name: ext2_write
methods.description: Writes data to an open file.

methods.name: ext2_lseek
methods.description: Repositions the read/write offset within a file.

methods.name: ext2_tell
methods.description: Returns the current offset within a file.

methods.name: ext2_truncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified length.

methods.name: ext2_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes a file's in-memory state with storage.

methods.name: ext2_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory for reading entries.

methods.name: ext2_rename
methods.description: Renames or moves a file or directory.

methods.name: ext2_stat
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file or directory.

methods.name: ext2_mkfs
methods.description: Formats a storage device with ext2 filesystem.
